Pattern gallery, page 1 of 8 (15-minute bars, MES / MNQ / MYM)

Purple circle = the detected pattern; yellow = its bars; light blue = the 5 bars after; arrow = entry at the next open to the close 5 bars later. EMA 8 red, 20 orange, 50 blue; VWAP light blue; dots = 3-bar swing points, diamonds = 10-bar swing points (only those already confirmed when the pattern appears). Momentum(14) below.

doji (neutral)

Rule: body <= 0.1 x avgR10 (TA-Lib BodyDoji). 126,067 occurrences on 15-minute bars across the three markets.

dragonfly doji (bullish)

Rule: doji AND upper shadow <= 0.1 x range AND lower shadow >= 0.6 x range -> bullish. 8,610 occurrences on 15-minute bars across the three markets.

gravestone doji (bearish)

Rule: doji AND lower shadow <= 0.1 x range AND upper shadow >= 0.6 x range -> bearish. 8,071 occurrences on 15-minute bars across the three markets.

hammer (bullish)

Rule: range >= avgR10, lower shadow >= 2 x body, upper <= 0.1 x range, prior close < EMA10 -> bullish. 6,535 occurrences on 15-minute bars across the three markets.

hanging man (bearish)

Rule: hammer shape after prior close > EMA10 -> bearish (textbook). 4,816 occurrences on 15-minute bars across the three markets.

inverted hammer (bullish)

Rule: range >= avgR10, upper >= 2 x body, lower <= 0.1 x range, prior close < EMA10 -> bullish (textbook). 4,130 occurrences on 15-minute bars across the three markets.
